title: Luma Travel — priority-four journey maps, 7 stages each (P09 Halina, P14 Bernard, P04 Reuben, P12 Jaden)
superseded_reason: Opportunities column flagged by Agentic Designer - RP as unevidenced design reasoning. v2 grounds the 4 stage-level Opportunities cells that carry the personas' main pain against ART-039 (new competitive-benchmark). Payload otherwise unchanged.

method.skill: journey-map (customer-journey-mapping base + CoForge extensions §16, loaded this session)
method.claim_format: Evidenced [ART-030 § section] where ART-030 places the claim at that stage; Inferred [ART-030 § section/persona] elsewhere — no cell states more than the source supports
method.gate_b: no raw hex outside :root token block (values match design-system/tokens/tokens.json — bone #eeece6, ink #041222, coral #f15b40), no raw px outside the token/spacing scale, zero minted [E-nnn] IDs, synthetic banner present in header and footer, Anek Latin for prose, Source Code Pro for labels/IDs/citations, tabular-nums class available for any numeral runs

structure.selection: Same four personas as ART-035, same selection_criteria — reused here rather than re-derived. Scope narrowed from an initial 14-persona draft to match ART-035 at the direction of Agentic Designer - RP, 2026-09-15.
structure.one_map_per_persona: Each of the 4 <section class="pj"> blocks is a complete, self-contained one-actor journey map (diagram-cartographer hard rule: one actor per map) bundled into a single document — same bundling precedent as ART-035 (4 personas, one file) and ART-036 (zip package).

notes: No quotes used anywhere — evidence ledger holds zero entries, ADR-024 in force.

Every stage cell is graded Evidenced/Inferred against ART-030 at the per-stage level, not the per-persona level: a persona can be Evidenced at its grounded pain stage and Inferred/Low everywhere else in the same map.

P09 (Disabled/Assisted segment) carries the same grounding caveat ART-030 §2 states for that register: regulator/market evidence, thin first-person voice, Reddit blocked by policy. Coral top accent applied only to this segment per the visual spec.

Scope history: this artifact was first drafted covering all 14 ART-030 personas, then trimmed to the same 4 as ART-035 at the user's explicit direction. The other 10 sections (P01, P02, P03, P05, P06, P07, P08, P10, P11, P13) were authored and verified before being removed — not skipped for lack of time — should a future run need the full 14 restored.
Figma package deferred pending Gate A sign-off on this HTML, per journey-map skill §16 CoForge extensions ('Human approves the HTML before any Figma package is produced').
